# AI_QUESTIONS — issue #162 (PR #185): `Closes #162` in the PR body

The two open review threads on `docs/implementation/OWNER_ACTIONS.md` ask for `Refs #162` instead of `Closes #162`.

**Root cause (not fixable from this branch):** the PR body is generated by the hub's start job in `AbdelrhmanAh7/nql-agents/bin` (see `.github/workflows/ai-implementers.yml:6`, "ONE PR \"Closes #n\"") and always writes a closing keyword. An implementer branch cannot change a PR body, the hub script or a workflow (owner rule: CI changes always stop at the owner).

**Already done on this branch (repo side):**
- `docs/implementation/OWNER_ACTIONS.md` requires `Refs #162` for PRs touching that section.
- `.github/pull_request_template.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `docs/GITHUB_WORKFLOW.md`: owner-tracking issues (`owner-only` / `needs-owner`) use `Refs #N`.

**Needed from the owner / harness (please do before merging PR #185):**
1. Edit the PR #185 body: replace `Closes #162` with `Refs #162`. Otherwise merging auto-closes the founder's tracking issue while all five rows are still pending.
2. In `nql-agents/bin` (PR-body step of the start job): emit `Refs #n` instead of `Closes #n` when issue `n` has the label `owner-only` or `needs-owner`; optionally also lint the body of every PR in `docs.yml` for that combination.
